props.title: The Chemistry of Ancient Color: Field Symposium 2026
props.subtitle: A gathering of archaeological chemists, master dyers, and textile artists in the Aegean

props.heading: Bridging Spectrometry & Traditional Vats
props.subheading: Five days of immersive field research, botanical foraging, and anaerobic fermentation
props.col1: Natural dyes represent one of humanity's oldest and most sophisticated biotechnologies. Over five days, researchers and artists will bridge the divide between laboratory science and living studio traditions.
props.col2: Participants will engage in chromatographic analysis of wild pigments, explore historic fermentation vats with date and lime reductions, and dye unbleached linen with native Mediterranean flora.
